title: File:Senate Park Commission plan for Arlington Memorial Bridge - 1902.jpg
author: Report of the Senate Park Commission. The Improvement of the Park System of the District of Columbia. United States Senate. Committee on the District of Columbia. 57th Cong., 1st sess. Washington, D.C.: U.S. Government Printing Office, 1902, frontispiece.
description: A black-and-white version of a watercolor showing the general position of the proposed Arlington Memorial Bridge across the Potomac River in Washington, D.C., in the United States.  The image also shows the location of the proposed Lincoln Memorial, upper right. The bridge extends across the Potomac River to a greatly refigured Columbia Island, and then across teh Boundary Channel to the Virginia shoreline.
